capabilities: sync Dedao ebook highlights into one folder per book with one note per highlight
include margin notes under the original highlighted text
discover every book with highlights by walking the note stream
backfill full history with resumable, rate-limit-aware batching
schedule pulls at intervals from 5 minutes to 1 week
extras: Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; community plugin install is pending review, so BRAT or manual installation is offered in the meantime. Docs include a Chinese-language section.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull highlights and margin notes from the Dedao Brain (得到大脑) service into local Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin is a client of openapi.biji.com only.

requires.name: Dedao Brain OpenAPI credential pair (apiToken + clientId)

summary: Syncs Dedao (得到) ebook highlights and margin notes into per-book Markdown folders via the official Dedao Brain OpenAPI.
